prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1266; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to my situation, if that's okay. I can tell you what happened.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were and what you were doing when the collision occurred?
A: I was driving through an intersection in Sugar Land, heading straight through on a green light. I had just come up to the crosswalk area when a car came out from the cross street.
Q: Which direction was the other vehicle coming from?
A: From my right. It came across my lane and hit the driver's side of my car. I didn't see it until the last second, and I couldn't stop in time.
Q: Did you have any warning before impact, like a horn or brake lights?
A: Maybe a quick horn, but I'm not sure. It all happened very fast.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Did you hit your head during the collision?
A: I did. My head hit the side window and I felt dizzy right away. I had a headache that got worse over the next few hours.
Q: Did you lose consciousness, even briefly?
A: I don't think I passed out, but everything went blurry for a moment and I was confused about where I was.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the accident?
A: Yes, I was taken to the emergency room and they diagnosed me with a concussion. I've been told to rest and avoid screens for a while.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?
A: Yes. I still get headaches, I'm sensitive to light, and I have trouble concentrating at work.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm working with my doctor on recovery and I'll share the medical records when I have them.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
